title: Transferring Pyramid
statementMd:
Vasya and Petya are using an interesting data storing structure: a pyramid.

The pyramid consists of $*n*$ rows, the $*i*$-th row contains $*i*$ cells. Each row is shifted half a cell to the left relative to the previous row. The cells are numbered by integers from 1 to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5e54199c623e6698508e30637903d25ae30f0d42.png) as shown on the picture below.

An example of a pyramid at $*n* = 5$ is:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/31141e183e25c84a2d719254fc413c2c38675cbc.png)

This data structure can perform operations of two types:

1. Change the value of a specific cell. It is described by three integers: $"*t* *i* *v*"$, where $*t* = 1$ (the type of operation), $*i*$ — the number of the cell to change and $*v*$ the value to assign to the cell.
2. Change the value of some subpyramid. The picture shows a highlighted subpyramid with the top in cell $5$. It is described by $*s* + 2$ numbers: $"*t* *i* *v*_{1} *v*_{2} ... *v*_{*s*}"$, where $*t* = 2$, $*i*$ — the number of the top cell of the pyramid, $*s*$ — the size of the subpyramid (the number of cells it has), $*v*_{*j*}$ — the value you should assign to the $*j*$-th cell of the subpyramid.

Formally: a subpyramid with top at the $*i*$-th cell of the $*k*$-th row (the $5$-th cell is the second cell of the third row) will contain cells from rows from $*k*$ to $*n*$, the $(*k* + *p*)$-th row contains cells from the $*i*$-th to the $(*i* + *p*)$-th ($0 ≤ *p* ≤ *n* - *k*$).

Vasya and Petya had two identical pyramids. Vasya changed some cells in his pyramid and he now wants to send his changes to Petya. For that, he wants to find a sequence of operations at which Petya can repeat all Vasya's changes. Among all possible sequences, Vasya has to pick the minimum one (the one that contains the fewest numbers).

You have a pyramid of $*n*$ rows with $*k*$ changed cells. Find the sequence of operations which result in **each of the $*k*$ changed cells being changed by at least one operation**. Among all the possible sequences pick **the one that contains the fewest numbers**.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *k* ≤ 10^{5}$).

The next $*k*$ lines contain the coordinates of the modified cells $*r*_{*i*}$ and $*c*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$ — the row and the cell's number in the row. All cells are distinct.

## Output

Print a single number showing how many numbers the final sequence has.

## Note

One of the possible solutions of the first sample consists of two operations:

$2 4 *v*_{4} *v*_{7} *v*_{8}$

$2 6 *v*_{6} *v*_{9} *v*_{10}$

The picture shows the changed cells color-highlighted. The subpyramid used by the first operation is highlighted blue and the subpyramid used by the first operation is highlighted yellow:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b94154aa23cf9599f28f9e48e25d1c413c2730f4.png)
statementZhMd:
Vasya 和 Petya 使用一种有趣的数据存储结构：金字塔。

金字塔由 $*n*$ 行组成，第 $*i*$ 行包含 $*i*$ 个单元格。每一行相对于前一行向左偏移半个单元格。单元格的编号为从 1 到 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5e54199c623e6698508e30637903d25ae30f0d42.png) 的整数，如下图所示。

当 $*n* = 5$ 时，金字塔的示例如下：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/31141e183e25c84a2d719254fc413c2c38675cbc.png)

这种数据结构可以执行以下两种操作：

1. 修改指定单元格的值。该操作由三个整数描述：$"*t* *i* *v*"$，其中 $*t* = 1$（操作类型），$*i*$ 表示要修改的单元格编号，$*v*$ 表示要赋给该单元格的值。
2. 修改某个子金字塔的值。下图展示了一个顶点位于单元格 5 的高亮子金字塔。该操作由 $*s* + 2$ 个数字描述：$"*t* *i* *v*_{1} *v*_{2} ... *v*_{*s*}"$，其中 $*t* = 2$，$*i*$ 表示金字塔顶端单元格的编号，$*s*$ 表示子金字塔的大小（即其中包含的单元格数量），$*v*_{*j*}$ 表示应赋给子金字塔中第 $*j*$ 个单元格的值。

形式化地说：一个顶点位于第 $*k*$ 行第 $*i*$ 个单元格的子金字塔（第 $5$ 个单元格是第三行的第二个单元格）将包含从第 $*k*$ 行到第 $*n*$ 行的单元格，其中第 $(*k* + *p*)$ 行包含从第 $*i*$ 个到第 $(*i* + *p*)$ 个单元格（$0 ≤ *p* ≤ *n*$ - $*k*$）。

Vasya 和 Petya 有两个完全相同的金字塔。Vasya 修改了自己金字塔中的一些单元格，现在他想将这些修改发送给 Petya。为此，他希望找到一个操作序列，使 Petya 可以重复 Vasya 的所有修改。在所有可能的序列中，Vasya 必须选择最短的一个（即包含数字数量最少的序列）。

现在给定一个有 $*n*$ 行、其中有 $*k*$ 个单元格被修改过的金字塔。请找出一个操作序列，使得这 $*k*$ 个被修改的单元格中的**每一个都至少被某个操作修改一次**。在所有可能的序列中，选择**包含数字数量最少的一个**。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *k* ≤ 10^{5}$）。

接下来的 $*k*$ 行包含被修改单元格的坐标 $*r*_{*i*}$ 和 $*c*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$），分别表示行号以及该单元格在所在行中的编号。所有单元格均不相同。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示最终序列中包含的数字数量。

## 说明

第一组样例的一种可能解包含两个操作：

$2 4 *v*_{4} *v*_{7} *v*_{8}$

$2 6 *v*_{6} *v*_{9} *v*_{10}$

图片中用不同颜色高亮显示了被修改的单元格。第一个操作使用的子金字塔以蓝色高亮显示，第一个操作使用的子金字塔以黄色高亮显示：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b94154aa23cf9599f28f9e48e25d1c413c2730f4.png)
